selection_objective: Maximum arithmetic mean five-session raw-price label less declared round-trip cost proxy, measured only in eligible training episodes; ties use selection_candidates order. Cash is eligible with zero score.

splitter.note: No development folds: one reserved selection only, mirroring evaluate.py reserved_train = last 252 decision sessions before a six-session exclusion.

decision: At completed close t, select highest positive close[t]/close[t-lookback]-1; ties alphabetically by asset. Otherwise cash. Asset set is fixed ex ante for this engineering experiment.
episode_anchor: Reserved start session 2012-10-01 has offset zero; decision sessions at offsets divisible by five, for both training and reserved episodes.
price_convention: Unadjusted bundled LEAN integer prices divided by 10000. Open-to-open raw price labels only; cash distributions, financing, liquidity, execution and broker fees are NOT modeled. Cost is an illustrative per-episode fully-invested 20-basis-point deduction, proportional to total allocated weight; cash has zero cost. No compounding, cash account, position or simulated P&L claim.
corporate_action_policy: Reject nonconstant split factors or ticker changes whose effective factor/map interval overlaps 2014-01-02 through 2021-03-31. Dividend-related price-factor changes are retained as an explicit raw-price limitation.
selection_boundary: Reserved selection uses exactly the last 252 decision sessions before a six-session exclusion preceding 2012-10-01; every training label exit must precede 2012-10-01. Selection written exclusively before reserved labels are materialized.
embargo: No future-side training in this strictly chronological design, so no additional post-evaluation embargo. The six-session exclusion follows the declared label horizon; exact intervals are checked independently. This does not guarantee statistical independence.
reserved_policy: Scored exactly once. Window chosen because it precedes the research-evaluation data_start 2014-01-02, precedes broad-universe warm-up 2016-01-04, and ends before the 2013-10-07..11 LEAN sample week used by engine/data/hosting receipts. Public bundled data is not demonstrated globally unseen.
incomplete_labels: Retain incomplete episode records as censored when exit falls beyond the development_end or reserved_end segment boundary; do not fill, infer or include them in scoring. Development evaluation labels may extend beyond an individual 63-session fold while remaining within the development segment; future outcomes never enter an earlier selection.
scope: Chronological engineering control on three selected ETFs; no catalyst, +200% mover, PIT universe, original observation-time or alpha acceptance.

expected_sessions.total: counted from dates only before freeze: 385 sessions 2011-03-23..2012-09-28 and 250 sessions 2012-10-01..2013-09-30 per asset (date column only; no price read)

significance_test.primary: Two-sided one-sample t-test (scipy.stats.ttest_1samp, popmean 0) on paired per-episode differences net_proxy(selected) - net_proxy(equalweight) over completed reserved episodes; alpha 0.05.
secondary: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (scipy.stats.wilcoxon, zero_method wilcox) on the same differences.
Descriptive two-sided one-sample t-tests of each invested candidate net_proxy mean vs 0, Holm-corrected across invested candidates; cash excluded (identically zero).
significance_test.if_selected_is_equalweight: equalweight is not a selection candidate, so the paired test is always defined; if selected is cash, differences are -net_proxy(equalweight).
significance_test.consequence: No tuning, promotion, rerun or alpha claim regardless of p-values.
